id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

data.description:
Incoming data for the visualization. Must be in JSON format for the downstream React component to be able to
handle it cleanly.

columnNames.description:
The columns from the data frame. These will be used to generate the columns for the grid representation of the
visualization.

showGridSwitch.description:
Whether to show the switch that toggles between the grid and the chart. In general, all visualizations should
support switching to a grid view except for the grid itself.

downloadOptions.description:
The download options available for the visualization. This is used to render the download action buttons in the
header.

defaultVisualization.description:
The visualization to show when the container is first rendered. The user may later switch to the grid view, but
this default visualization will be stored in case the user switches back.

defaultVisualizationLabel.description: The label to render in the grid switcher for the default visualization.

evalMetricsSpec.description:
If the visualization was rendered from an `evalMetrics` call, the spec is passed to the visualization container
in order to render a popover that allows the user to modify the `evalMetricsSpec` and regenerate the visualization
without needing to enter a follow-up query.

evalSpec.description:
If the visualization was rendered from an `eval` call, the spec is passed to the visualization container in order
to render a popover that allows the user to modify the `evalSpec` and regenerate the visualization without needing
to enter a follow-up query.

title:
Props for the presentational GenAiUiVisualizationContainer UI component that wraps a Gen AI
Visualization. The component supports switching between the default visualization and a grid view.
name: GenAiUiVisualizationContainer
